description: A town street ready for a level, laid out along X and centred on the road (Y up, metres): the road with kerbs, pavements, lane markings, a zebra crossing and lamp posts on both pavements; on the -Z side a row of houses as wide as house_width, as many as fit, each with its own depth, plaster colour, roof (gable along the street, gable facing it or hipped), door colour and chimneys, and a fenced back garden with a tree; on the +Z side a park behind a hedge, with a winding promenade, entrances from the pavement, a round plaza, trees, bushes and benches. Everything stays within the street's length and 70 m across it (z from -35 to 35), on the ground at y = 0. Walls, roofs, lamps, fences, trees, bushes and benches come from TopoTopo's own architecture, street and nature packages; trees, bushes, benches, lamps and chimneys are packed instances.

street_length.label: street length
street_length.desc: length of the street along X (m)

road_width.label: road width
road_width.desc: width of the road between the kerbs (m)

house_width.label: house width
house_width.desc: frontage of each house (m); as many houses as fit along the street

lamp_spacing.label: lamp spacing
lamp_spacing.desc: largest distance between lamp posts along a pavement (m), on both pavements

park_density.label: park density
park_density.desc: how full of trees and bushes the park is

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: changes the houses' details, the props and the trees, not the layout

street_line.note: the road's centre line, 5 cm up: the kerb and pavement slabs reach 5 cm below it, so they rest on the ground

kerbs_and_pavements.note: the package's asphalt is a thin ribbon: a solid slab replaces it

lamp_pts.note: evenly spread, as many as keep them at most lamp_spacing apart

lamp_survey.note: measures the lamps as cooked: per pavement the largest gap between neighbours and the distance from the street's ends; lamp_rows counts the pavements lined with two or more lamps (0 when a lamp stands off both pavements)

lamps_both_sides.note: both pavements carry a row of lamp posts, and none stands off them

lamps_spacing.note: neighbours along a pavement never more than lamp_spacing apart

lamps_to_the_ends.note: the rows reach the street's ends: the first and last lamp stand within half a spacing of them

street_paint.note: Cd follows each prim's material (the recoloured walls, roofs and doors too), for viewers and formats that show Cd

params.code:
const table = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}');
for (let p = 0; p < nprims(0); p++) { const m = table[prim(0, 'material', p)]; if (m) setprimattrib(0, 'Cd', p, m.baseColor); }

lots.note: one point per house at the middle of its front wall: as many houses as fit with gaps of at least 1.6 m, spread evenly; each draws its details from the seed (neighbours never share a roof or a colour)

front_ground.note: a shop front (two wide windows) or a house front, door in the middle

chimney_pts.note: one or two chimneys per house astride its ridge, their foot 1 m inside the roof

garden_lines.note: the gardens behind the houses: a fence along the back, and one between every two houses and at both ends, from 2 m behind the fronts

garden_fences.note: one plank fence along every garden line

garden_tree_sites.note: a tree in the middle of every garden

params.names: depth roof pitch colour tiles door_colour shop windows side_windows

house_paint.note: Cd follows each prim's material (the recoloured walls, roofs and doors too), for viewers and formats that show Cd

params.code:
const table = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}');
for (let p = 0; p < nprims(0); p++) { const m = table[prim(0, 'material', p)]; if (m) setprimattrib(0, 'Cd', p, m.baseColor); }

park_rect.note: the park: from the pavement's back edge to 35 m from the road's centre, the whole street long

path_lines.note: the promenade winds along the park; entrances run from the pavement to it, the middle one opposite the zebra crossing

plaza_bench_pts.note: four benches on the diagonals round the plaza, facing its middle

params.names: orient N up tangent curveu curve_id side path

tree_rect.note: trees keep 3.5 m from the park's ends and back (their crowns stay inside) and 2.5 m from the pavement

tree_scatter_up.note: workaround: the scatter writes the ground normal N, which would turn the copies; drop it so the trees stand upright

tree_sites.note: on the lawn; turned in quarter turns, so their bounds stay exact

bush_rect.note: bushes keep 2.2 m from the park's ends and back (their bounds turned any way stay inside), and stay behind the hedge

bush_scatter_up.note: workaround: drop the scatter's N so the bushes stand upright

hedge_lines.note: a hedge along the pavement, open where the entrances come in

params.code:
f@yaw = rand(@ptnum, seed, 7) * 360;
f@size = 0.9 + rand(@ptnum, seed, 8) * 0.2;

params.names: orient N up tangent curveu curve_id

park_paint.note: Cd follows each prim's material (the recoloured walls, roofs and doors too), for viewers and formats that show Cd

for (let p = 0; p < nprims(0); p++) { const m = table[prim(0, 'material', p)]; if (m) setprimattrib(0, 'Cd', p, m.baseColor); }

block_grounded.note: every point of the block (the instances' anchors too) on or above the ground; the instances' own bounds are checked by each part's asserts

block.note: every point of the block within the street's length and 70 m across; the instances' own bounds are checked by each part's asserts

street.label: Street
street.description: The road with kerbs, pavements, lane markings and a zebra crossing, and lamp posts on both pavements (packed instances).

houses.label: Houses
houses.description: The row of houses along the -Z pavement: walls with windows and doors, gable or hip roofs and chimneys (packed instances), and behind them fenced back gardens with a tree each (packed instances).

park.label: Park
park.description: The park along the +Z pavement: the lawn, gravel paths and a plaza, and trees, bushes and benches (packed instances).

block.label: Block
block.description: The street, the houses and the park together on the ground: a 70 m deep level block as long as the street.
